data_issues: (1) The label field is wrong on about 18 of 79 labeled trials (14/64 train, 4/15 val): it disagrees with the stimulus-log category, so I trained on category instead. (2) 14 of the 40 neurons (indices 5,8,9,10,16,18,21,22,24,25,31,32,35,36) give exactly zero spikes on every test trial, although they fire normally in train/val (some at 6-14 spikes). That looks like dropped channels/sessions in the test set, so the decoder uses only the 26 neurons that are still active.
